text: I'll keep this as clear as I can because I want a straight answer, not a list of maybes. My stepson is 2 months old. He's been warm since this evening and I've just taken his temperature with the digital thermometer under his arm, twice to be sure. It read 39.1 both times. His mum is on a night shift and can't pick up, so it's me deciding what happens next. For what it's worth, his breathing looks normal to me. I've watched his chest for a good few minutes and it's steady, nothing fast or strange. He's also feeding fine. He took his full bottle about forty minutes ago, same amount as always, and kept it down. So apart from the temperature he seems like himself. I've read conflicting things online about babies this young with a fever and I'd rather hear it from someone who actually knows. Does he need to be seen tonight or can this wait until the GP opens in the morning. Please just tell me which.
